OFFICIAL SYLLABUS

Unit V scope from the course handout

Mechanisms of plastic deformation, slip and twinning; types of fracture; fracture mechanics; Griffith's theory; testing of materials under tensile, compression and shear loads; hardness tests – Brinell, Vickers and Rockwell; micro- and nano-hardness tests; impact tests – Izod and Charpy; fatigue and creep failure mechanisms.

STUDY CHECKLIST

Topics for Unit V revision

Use the student-notes PDF alongside this syllabus checklist.

  • Plastic deformation: slip and twinning
  • Ductile, brittle and fatigue fracture
  • Fracture mechanics and Griffith's theory
  • Tensile, compression and shear testing
  • Brinell, Vickers and Rockwell hardness testing
  • Micro-hardness and nano-hardness
  • Izod and Charpy impact tests
  • Fatigue and creep failure mechanisms
